newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK XIOSBANK TO GO PUBLIC, AIMS BOURSE LISTING.
newsitem.headline: GREEK XIOSBANK TO GO PUBLIC, AIMS BOURSE LISTING.

text.p: Greece's private Xiosbank filed with the Athens bourse for listing on its main market. It will go ahead with an IPO of 1,592,450 new shares and a private placement of 79,610 shares, it said on Monday.

Its share capital after the initial public offering will amount to 7,962,220 ordinary registered shares with a par value of 1,000 drachmas. The IPO price will be announced shortly before IPO subscriptions, it said.
Xiosbank will tap the market for over 4.0 billion drachmas and use IPO proceeds to finance its 1997-2000 investment programme.
Part of the plan is to expand its branch network by 20 to number 45 branches by the year 2000.

"Xiosbank is a leader in consumer credit with innovative products. Its management aims to continue this leadership with new financial products that meet consumer needs and enhance customer service," the bank said in a statement.
Issue advisor is Telesis Securities with state National Bank of Greece the lead underwriter.
